extensions.description: This agent's interface is MCP over stdio, not A2A. The card is a capability manifest and discovery record, not an A2A endpoint declaration; no A2A endpoint exists for this agent. The params carry the invocation facts a client config generator needs to wire this server from the card alone.

description: Read-only operator instrumentation for the vongola TLS gateway. Five read-only tools over a running vongola daemon — routes, certificates, TLS statistics, upstream health, and log counters; no tool changes anything. This card is a discovery record and capability manifest for catalogues, registries, and client-config generators; Vongola does not expose an A2A endpoint.
name: Vongola

skills.description: Certificate status, TLS handshake statistics (handshakes, failures, classical fallbacks), and the daemon's route table (cert_status, tls_stats, routes_list).
skills.name: TLS, certificates, routes

skills.description: Upstream health and latency, and log-line counters including dropped lines (upstream_health, log_counters).
skills.name: Upstream and log telemetry
